allocation.history_scope: all existing reference N288 training-only bundles at voltage_sigma=0.0002, PQ_sigma=0.005; no validation/test/V/results
allocation.normalization: normalize size factors within each network so total inventory equals 0.20*sum nodal q90(max(P,0))
allocation.assignment: SHA256(seed|case|label|purpose); hash-ordered nodes cycle through mix templates; no topology or identification outcome
allocation.grid_reason: No declared terminal actuator: retain optional template without inventing installed grid resources

resource_limits.matched_enrollment: paper15 retains sum enrolled resource kW<=2; other networks scale 2 by training positive-net mean-power ratio to paper15
resource_limits.aggregation: enrolled kW counts every resource before node netting; physical power and energy scale with enrolled share
resource_limits.sufficiency_check: report full-inventory per-slot directional power / matched enrollment cap; >=2 is a declared diagnostic, not an identifiability guarantee
resource_limits.legacy_contract: old 2 kW synthetic single-resource experiments are unchanged; changed resource/energy/cost model requires matched new comparisons

price.ev_unavailable_period_price: ignored by zero power availability, not an offer to buy daytime EV energy
price.mean_response: signed nominal u = direction * A_direction * pi / c, 0<=pi<=c; A_direction is headroom at enrolled scale, not nameplate
price.prepaid_contract: C=dt*sum c*(u_plus^2/A_plus+u_minus^2/A_minus); zero A requires zero u; opposite directions cannot activate simultaneously on one resource
price.settlement: fixed planned service reward, no refund/redraw after underdelivery; report delivered quantities separately
price.cost_contents: all-in service compensation; do not add the same inconvenience/wear again
price.old_fee_conversion: 44.9505 old contract units are not converted to CNY

user.baseline: embedded synthetic component A*availability; original total load receives only actual increment

ev.baseline: constant charging during 14 connected hours; 20/7 kWh per enrolled charger kW per overnight session
ev.midnight_accounting: 00:00 vehicle has already received 6/14 of previous session energy; fulfill remaining 8/14 by 08:00. New arrival at 18:00 must receive 6/14 by 24:00; separate segment equality prevents borrowing across disconnection or next day
ev.template_boundary: fractional contracted fleet share, not fractional physical vehicle count; residence timing, energy and 50 kWh battery are assumptions

battery.energy_accounting: count recharge and losses; no free terminal energy or perfect-efficiency replacement

response.formula: U_raw=u*(m+nu_type*nu_node*nu_time*Z); Var Z=1; node-day factor shared across types at same node
response.execution: causal device/state-feasible delivery; clipping must also preserve SOC/deadline feasibility; slot-only clipping is insufficient for EV/storage
response.calibration: assumed continuous correlated delivery, not calibrated participation probabilities

forecast.predictor: training same-slot mean P/Q; other predictors may replace this later
forecast.scale: per-slot training RMS, not abs signed net forecast near zero; fixed before test
forecast.basis: synthetic working distribution, not 3-day covariance calibration
forecast.status: recorded only; existing predictor/noise pipeline unchanged

evidence_sources.supports: 5 kW / 12.5 kWh and 85 percent roundtrip reference; SOC/cost/penetration are our assumptions
evidence_sources.reading: official indexed parameter text in previous literature pass; direct page fetch returned 502

evidence_sources.supports: EV power, availability and energy feasibility; numerical charger range 7-13 kW
evidence_sources.reading: open author full text; residential schedule here is not their workplace schedule

evidence_sources.supports: numerical charging incentive range 0.25-0.45 CNY/kWh; not field elasticity calibration
2025 policy compensation reference, not a topology probing tariff or marginal cost
